'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]; [[December 2020 Afghanistan targeted killings]]
**A [[car bomb]]ing in [[Kabul]] targeting Khan Mohammad Wardak, a lawmaker, kills nine people and wounds more than 20 others. Wardak is among the injured. Attacks also occur in [[Logar Province|Logar]], [[Nangarhar Province|Nangarhar]], [[Helmand Province|Helmand]], and [[Badakhshan Province|Badakhshan]], with an unknown number of civilians and security forces killed. No group claims responsibility for these attacks. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attack/nine-dead-as-kabul-car-bombing-targets-afghan-lawmaker-idUSKBN28U097?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Iraqi conflict]]
**Eight rockets are fired at the [[Embassy of the United States, Baghdad|U.S. Embassy]] in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]], prompting the activation of [[Counter rocket, artillery, and mortar|C-RAM]] [[air defence]]s. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/iraqi-officials-rockets-target-us-embassy-baghdad-74831850 (ABC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**[[U.S.]] [[Senate Majority Leader]] [[Mitch McConnell]] announces that [[United States Congress|Congress]] has reached a deal on a [[United States dollar|$]]900 billion [[COVID-19]] relief package that includes a new round of direct payments and help for families, businesses and [[unemployment in the United States|unemployed]] [[Americans]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/20/us/politics/congress-stimulus-deal.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2020 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[2020 Pacific typhoon season#Tropical Storm Krovanh (Vicky)|Tropical Storm Krovanh (Vicky)]] makes [[landfall]] in the [[Philippines]], resulting in the deaths of at least eight people and forcing the evacuation of nearly 10,000 others. [https://www.nst.com.my/world/region/2020/12/651055/eight-dead-philippine-floods-thousands-flee-homes (AFP via ''New Straits Times'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Jersey]]
*****[[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] announces that they will close the [[Robbinsville Township, New Jersey|Robbinsville Township]] facility, also known as the PNE5, after several workers tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/12/20/amazon-closes-new-jersey-warehouse-after-covid-19-infections.html (CNBC)]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
*****The [[United States]] begins shipping the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|made by]] [[Moderna]]. [https://www.wsj.com/amp/articles/u-s-starts-rollout-of-modernas-covid-19-vaccine-11608460200 (''Wall Street Journal'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nunavut]]
*****[[Nunavut]] reports its first two deaths from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] complications. [https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2020/12/20/nunavut-reports-two-covid-19-deaths-which-are-its-first-from-the-novel-coronavirus.html (''Toronto Star'')]
****[[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****The [[Government of Canada|federal government]] restricts travel to and from the [[United Kingdom]] for 72 hours from tomorrow due to emergence to a new variant of SARS-CoV-2. The restrictions do not apply to [[Air cargo|cargo flights]] or stops where passengers do not disembark. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/politics/canada-restricts-travel-from-u-k-due-to-new-covid-19-strain-1.5239455 (CTV News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in El Salvador]]
****[[El Salvador]] bans travelers who have been in the United Kingdom or [[South Africa]] in the last 30 days or whose flights included a layover in those countries. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-el-salvador-britain-idUSE1N2HU00C (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 221 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 19,880. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5302717/rekor-baru-ini-sebaran-221-kematian-covid-19-jateng-jatim-tertinggi (detikHealth)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Iran]] suspends flights to and from the United Kingdom for two weeks due to the emergence of a new variant of [[SARS-CoV-2]] that was discovered in the UK. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-britain-iran/iran-suspends-flights-to-uk-over-coronavirus-concerns-idINL1N2J00IC (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Israel]] bans entry of travelers from [[Denmark]], South Africa, and the United Kingdom due to the discovery of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in the latter country. Israeli citizens arriving from those countries will be required to quarantine at state-run quarantine hotels for up to 14 days. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/new-covid-19-mutation-will-force-more-israelis-to-isolate-652683 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Qatar]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****The Ministry of Public Health approves the authorization of the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] [[Tozinameran|vaccine]] for emergency use in [[Qatar]]. [https://www.gulf-times.com/story/680814/MoPH-approves-Pfizer-vaccine (''Gulf Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Saudi Arabia]] suspends all international [[passenger flights]] for one week as well as all entry through land and sea ports in response to a new variant of the SARS-COV-2 that was discovered in the United Kingdom. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1780261/saudi-arabia (''Arab News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a record 1,097 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total to 49,665 cases. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/covid-19-south-korea-record-high-cases-prison-major-outbreak-13809790 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****Belgium bans entry for incoming [[Eurostar|rail]] and air passengers from the United Kingdom for at least 24 hours, beginning at midnight. [[Virology|Virologist]] [[Marc Van Ranst]] said yesterday that a variant of SARS-COV-2 from the United Kingdom had been found in four cases from a sample of 2,000 analyses in his laboratory. [https://www.vrt.be/vrtnws/nl/2020/12/20/virussen-en-mutaties-hoe-zit-dat/ (VRT)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bulgaria]]
****The [[Government of Bulgaria|government]] announces the suspension of all flights between [[Bulgaria]] and the United Kingdom from tomorrow until January 31. Anyone who already arrived from the UK is required to quarantine for 10 days. [https://sofiaglobe.com/2020/12/20/bulgaria-decrees-10-day-quarantine-for-all-arrivals-from-uk/ (Sofia Globe)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]], [[Cluster 5]]
****[[Denmark]] will exhume four millions of [[mink]]s to prevention pollution contamination. This work will begin in May 2021, when the risk of coronavirus contamination from the dead animals has been eliminated. [https://www.dw.com/en/coronavirus-denmark-to-exhume-millions-of-minks-over-pollution-concerns/a-56003927 (DW)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Greece]] introduces a seven-day [[quarantine]] for people arriving from the United Kingdom beginning tomorrow at 6:00 a.m. local time due to the discovery of a new variant of SARS-COV-2 in the country. [https://news.gtp.gr/2020/12/20/greece-announces-7-day-quarantine-for-all-arrivals-from-the-uk/ (''Greek Travel Pages'')] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****Minister for Transport [[Eamon Ryan]] announces that the [[Government of Ireland|government]] will impose a 48-hour ban on flights to and from the United Kingdom from tomorrow following emergence of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2, while [[ferries]] will be limited to freight travel. [https://www.rte.ie/news/2020/1220/1185542-covid-19/ (RTE)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****The [[Government of the Netherlands|government]] orders a ban on [[passenger flight]]s from the United Kingdom from 6:00 a.m. today until at least January 1 due to the spread of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in the UK, with a case of the variant already having been reported in the [[Netherlands]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/netherlands-uk-flight-ban-covid-new-strain-b1776679.html (''The Independent'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Turkey]] temporarily suspend flights from the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Denmark, and South Africa due to concerns over a new variant of SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkey-suspends-some-flights-over-covid-19-mutation/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The United Kingdom reports a record 35,928 new cases in the past 24 hours. The [[government of the United Kingdom|government]] data also shows that 90% of local authorities in [[England]] have reported an increase in cases during the past week. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/global-health/science-and-disease/coronavirus-news-tier-4-london-christmas-cancelled-lockdown/ (''The Daily Telegraph'')]
*[[2020 H5N8 outbreak]]
**Over 8,000 ducks are expected to be culled after a third case of [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N8|H5N8]] [[avian influenza]] was confirmed at a farm in [[Norfolk]], UK. [https://www.edp24.co.uk/news/business/bird-flu-outbreak-confirmed-at-norfolk-duck-farm-6860270 (''Eastern Daily Press'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020 Tarlac shooting]]
**An off-duty [[Philippine National Police|police]] officer kills two unarmed neighbors in [[Paniqui]], [[Tarlac]], Philippines after opening fire against them following a dispute. The filmed incident circulates on social media hours later and sparks nationwide protests against [[police brutality]] and [[impunity]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-55376421 (BBC News)] [https://www.rappler.com/nation/jonel-nuezca-cop-killed-mother-son-tarlac-past-administrative-cases (Rappler)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[President of Nepal]] [[Bidya Devi Bhandari]] and [[Prime Minister of Nepal|Prime Minister]] [[KP Sharma Oli]] dissolve the incumbent [[House of Representatives (Nepal)|House of Representatives]], the lower house of the [[Federal Parliament of Nepal|Parliament]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/20/world/asia/nepal-parliament.html (''The New York Times'')]
